docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 Coverage - Part 02 of 06
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 with crewmembers Nick Hague (EV1, and camera 11), wearing Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) with red stripes, and Andrew Morgan (EV2 and camera 18), wearing EMU with no stripes. During the spacewalk Hague and Morgan install the second of 2 International Docking Adapters (IDA) to Pressurized Mating Adapter 3 (PMA-3). Includes footage of Hague and Morgan as they egress the Airlock; International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Scott Stover, CapCom Josh Matthew, Special Capcom Astronaut Mike Barratt, and Lead Spacewalk Officer Alex Kanelakos; EV1 and EV2 as they translate to work site; Morgan by Crew and Equlipment Translation Aid (CETA) 2 cart; split views of Morgan (left) and Hague as they set up Articulating Portable Foot Restraint (APFR); Hague and Morgan working route cables by PMA-3; and EV2 as he work to install jlumpers.

docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 Coverage - Part 05 of 06
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 with crewmembers Nick Hague (EV1, and camera 11), wearing Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) with red stripes, and Andrew Morgan (EV2 and camera 18), wearing EMU with no stripes. During the spacewalk Hague and Morgan install the second of 2 International Docking Adapters (IDA) to Pressurized Mating Adapter 3 (PMA-3). Includes footage of split screen of Hague and Morgan at their work sites; Hague as he takes photographs by PMA-3; Morgan as he opens the thermal cover to the Airlock; Hague as he approaches the Airlock; Hague as he hands Orbital Replacement Unit (ORU) bag to Morgan inside the Airlock;  International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Scott Stover, CapCom Josh Matthew, Special Capcom Astronaut Mike Barratt, and Lead Spacewalk Officer Alex Kanelakos; windowed view of exterior ISS, crewlock and equlipment lock; Hague as he ingresses the Airlock; interior crewlock; Airlock hatch closure; Kock and Luca Parmitano, European Space Agency (ESA) in Equipmentlock, as they wait for hatch opening; hatch opening and Koch and Parmitano as they assist Morgan and Hague with their EMUs.

docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 Coverage - Part 03 of 06
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 with crewmembers Nick Hague (EV1, and camera 11), wearing Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) with red stripes, and Andrew Morgan (EV2 and camera 18), wearing EMU with no stripes. During the spacewalk Hague and Morgan install the second of 2 International Docking Adapters (IDA) to Pressurized Mating Adapter 3 (PMA-3). Includes footage of Hague and Morgan as they works to route cables and hooks to the IDA; view of control panel inside the Node 2 Harmony Module; International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Scott Stover, CapCom Josh Matthew, Special Capcom Astronaut Mike Barratt, and Lead Spacewalk Officer Alex Kanelakos; Tracking map;  Special Purpose Dexterous Manipulator (SPDM) or DEXTRE as it moves away from the IDA; and Hague and Morgan as they complete the cable routing operations.

docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 Coverage - Part 04 of 06
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 with crewmembers Nick Hague (EV1, and camera 11), wearing Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) with red stripes, and Andrew Morgan (EV2 and camera 18), wearing EMU with no stripes. During the spacewalk Hague and Morgan install the second of 2 International Docking Adapters (IDA) to Pressurized Mating Adapter 3 (PMA-3). Includes footage of Morgan as he works to release Thermal Cover straps on the IDA;removal of the MultiLayer Insulation (MLI) Cover; Nice view of PMA-3 with IDA-3 installed; Hague as he translates to new work site;  International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Scott Stover, CapCom Josh Matthew, Special Capcom Astronaut Mike Barratt, and Lead Spacewalk Officer Alex Kanelakos; Morgan as he works to stow an IDA reflector inside Orbital Replacement Unit (ORU) bag; Hague as he photographs Spider Cable Connectors; Tracking map; and Morgan as he translates to Crew and Equipment Translation Aid (CETA Cart.

docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 Coverage - Part 01 of 06
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 60 US Spacewalk 55 with crewmembers Nick Hague (EV1, and camera 11), wearing Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) with red stripes, and Andrew Morgan (EV2 and camera 18), wearing EMU with no stripes. During the spacewalk Hague and Morgan install the second of 2 International Docking Adapters (IDA). Includes footage of Hague and Morgan wearing their EMUs in the Crew Airlock, assisted by crewmembers Christina Koch and Luca Parmitano, European Space Agency (ESA); photos and charts; views of Special Purpose Dexterous Manipulator (SPDM) or DEXTRE; Exterior views of Pressurized Mating Adapter 3 (PMA-3), IDA-3 and DEXTRE; Exterior ISS; International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Scott Stover, CapCom Josh Matthew, and Special Capcom Astronaut Mike Barratt; hatch closure to Equipment Lock; closeup of IDA-3; and hatch opening.
Koch & Parmitano assist Hague & Morgan with EMU On-Orbit Fitcheck Verification. RAW RED files archived on LTO D00219.
